title: A website playground I‘m building to easily test your spritesheets without coding or opening any game engine.
author: ilovebaozi
selftext:
This is a website playground I‘m building to easily test your spritesheets without coding or opening any game engine. Basically you can upload your spritesheets, modify some parameters and test your game directly!

The sprite assets used in this video is generated by my tool [rika-ai.com](http://rika-ai.com) in minutes so it's in pixel art style, but literally you can use any spritesheets you like. 

  
Currently it's only for side-view games, but I'll add support for top-down games if people like it. I wrote the game play part and vibe coded the website UI with Gemini. I'll push it to github very soon and release the link, so it will be open sourced and free to play for everyone. 

Tell me what you think!
